issue_context.title: store/driver: use BatchGet method supported in client-go
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Now that `client-go` have implemented `txn.BatchGet`, we can use it directly.

See: https://github.com/tikv/client-go/pull/109

review_comments: And could you please explain why we need to use TiKV's NotExist here?
Yes I understand it. I just recommend you briefly explain them in the code comments 😂
Oh, sorry.😂 I'll add the comments later.
Where would this method be used? Seems we're refactoring the `batchGet` in this PR?

1、`BatchGet` method in client-go will call this method. Like this: https://github.com/tikv/client-go/blob/b11da6307c6fc761e0d8841a72bccd578be1ef82/txnkv/transaction/batch_getter.go?_pjax=%23js-repo-pjax-container%2C%20div%5Bitemtype%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fschema.org%2FSoftwareSourceCode%22%5D%20main%2C%20%5Bdata-pjax-container%5D#L75
2、The purpose of this PR is to remove the repeated implementation of `BatchGet` method in `TiDB`, and directly use `BatchGet` method in `client-go`.
Could you please explain more clearly about why we need this struct and how this struct works?

We need to call `NewBufferBatchGetter` method in client-go. The type of the parameters to this method is different from TiDB. For example, the BatchGetter in TiDB is an interface that implements `BatchGet(ctx context.Context, keys []kv.Key)`, but in client-go, the BatchGetter is an interface that implements `BatchGet(ctx context.Context, keys [][]byte)`. So we need to abstract out a new class to implement this function `BatchGet(ctx context.Context, keys [][]byte)`.
